newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA CAPTAIN TAYLOR FAILS AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA CAPTAIN TAYLOR FAILS AGAIN.

text.p: Australia, reeling from their 3-0 one-day whitewash by England, made only 249 in their first innings against Gloucestershire on Tuesday.
Steve Waugh scored 92 and his brother Mark 66 but the rest of the batting was poor -- including struggling captain Mark Taylor, out for nought.
He edged paceman Mike Smith to wicketkeeper Jack Russell after lasting four balls.
The Waugh brothers batted solidly and added 96 for the fourth wicket in 29 overs.
Mark Waugh fell firt, driving left-arm spinner Richard Davis to Smith at mid-on. His 66 came off 101 balls and included 14 boundaries.
Steve Waugh hit the same amount of boundaries but then played outside the line to Smith. He faced 136 deliveries.
Pace bowler Jon Lewis, drafted into the county side at the last minute, took four for 89.
Gloucestershire reached 55 for the loss of Tony Wright before the close of the first of three days.
